page.layout: One printed page (right of the binding); running head with page number at top; body text in one column with mathematical displays and diagrams; a narrow strip of text at the left edge belongs to the facing left page and is not transcribed as part of this page's text (only the fragments visible at the gutter are left out).

uco, facli erunt 100 & 75, qui idem uolùt, ac si dicas,

page.notes: Mathematical display with fractions and ratio columns reproduced as lines; the fraction 2/7 and 5/7 are set as stacked numerals. Gutter fragments on the left edge (&, ul, ti-, ter, etc.) belong to the facing page and are omitted. Some numerals in the displays are uncertain.
